articles.mainIdea: The MIT-IBM Computing Research Lab Launches to Shape the Future of AI and Quantum Computing
articles.summary: PR Newswire: The MIT-IBM Computing Research Lab Launches to Shape the Future of AI and Quantum Computing. IBM (NYSE: IBM) and the Massachusetts Institute of Technology today announced the launch of the MIT-IBM Computing Research Lab, advancing their long-standing collaboration to shape the next era of computing. The new lab expands its scope to include quantum computing, alongside foundational artificial intelligence research, with the goal of unlocking new computational approaches that go beyond the limits of today's classical systems.
